_doc: Words for the generated catalog (scripts/build_catalog.py -> catalog/actions.csv). Ids come from catalog/action_tags.json and the tag values the workspace can produce; this file only says how each id reads. Per action: 'name' is a template ({tag} = phrases[tag][value], {tag.variant} = phrases['tag.variant'][value]); 'names' overrides it per tag suffix ('' = no tag); 'role' is the default, 'roles' overrides per suffix, 'risky_role' applies when any tag value is listed under 'risky'; 'values' lists literal tag values the routers set; 'optional' lists tags the workspace may leave out (the bare id is then reachable too); 'irreversible' mirrors the router's commit(..., irreversible=...). BehaviorGPT reads 'name': write it as a person would describe doing it.
